description: Starter-kit closure inventory for shipped skills, workflows, and their directly required source-owned surfaces.

keptSkills.rationale: Ship canonical skill surface for clone-ready starter use.
notes: Skill set currently ships as a complete bounded surface rather than a per-skill subset.
Shipped skills may reference source-only surfaces only when instructions explicitly label them source-only or conditional.

keptWorkflows.rationale: Ship workflow prompts referenced by starter instructions and generated runtime manifests.

sourceOnlyConditionalReferences.allowedWhen: Only in source repos that own adapter/runtime generation.
sourceOnlyConditionalReferences.action: Do not ship in consume-only starter kit. Source instructions must mark as conditional/source-only.

sourceOnlyConditionalReferences.allowedWhen: Only in source repos that own curated public publication.
sourceOnlyConditionalReferences.action: Do not ship in consume-only starter kit. Source instructions must mark as conditional/source-only.

requiredBehavior: Rebuild and validate generated export first.
Mirror full generated tree into sibling starter-kit repo rather than syncing selective subdirectories.
Verify parity between generated export and sibling repo before commit or push.
Block git publication when parity or prerequisite validation fails.

auditedAdjustments.change: Marked adapter-mapping and publication-config reads as source-only conditional references.
Dropped broad docs/superpowers copy and replaced it with empty starter directories plus targeted operating-system omissions.
